claim: For the periodic antiferromagnetic three-qubit \(XXX\) ring studied by Wang, Fu, and Solomon, take \(J>0\), \(T>0\), a uniform field \(B\), and let \(C(T,B)\) be the concurrence of any reduced pair. Put \(q=e^{3J/T}\) and \(q_0=4+3\sqrt2\). The source's exact field condition implies that there is no thermal entanglement for \(q\le q_0\), while for \(q>q_0\) there is one activation threshold \[B_*(T)=\frac{T}{2}\operatorname{arcosh}\!\left(\frac{(q+2)^2}{q^2-8q-2}\right)\]with \(C(T,B)>0\) exactly when \(|B|>B_*(T)\); this exact threshold is prior-source content rewritten explicitly. The new low-temperature result is a two-scale structure. First, \[B_*(T)\sim \sqrt6\,T e^{-3J/(2T)}\qquad(T\downarrow0).\]Second, around the zero-temperature saturation field \(B_c=3J/2\), for every fixed \(s\in\mathbb R\), \[\lim_{T\downarrow0}C\!\left(T,\frac{3J}{2}+sT\right)=\frac{2}{3(2+e^{2s})}.\]Consequently, every fixed \(B>3J/2\) has the activated tail \[C(T,B)\sim \frac23 e^{-2(B-3J/2)/T},\]every fixed \(0<|B|<3J/2\) has \(C(T,B)\to1/3\), and at \(|B|=3J/2\) one has \(C(T,B)\to2/9\). Thus the low-temperature field diagram contains an exponentially narrow activation layer near zero field and a distinct \(O(T)\) concurrence-amplitude boundary layer at the saturation transition.

integrity.computational_dependence: none for the proof; deterministic direct density-matrix replay is supplementary
integrity.novelty_scope: The original content is the exponentially small activation scale together with the universal saturation boundary-layer profile and fixed-high-field Arrhenius law; the exact finite-temperature field criterion is credited to the source.
integrity.ownership_basis: The mathematical bibliographic record for the anchor work lists primary MSC 81P15.
integrity.prior_work_preserved: The Hamiltonian, reduced density matrix, concurrence formula, exact field condition, and three zero-temperature concurrence limits are attributed to Wang, Fu, and Solomon.
integrity.source_date_basis: The anchor preprint arXiv:quant-ph/0105075 was first public on 2001-05-16.

scientific_limitations: The result concerns pairwise concurrence in the periodic three-qubit antiferromagnetic \(XXX\) ring with a uniform field.
The exact activation threshold is an algebraic inversion of the source criterion and is credited as prior content.
The saturation profile keeps \(s=(B-3J/2)/T\) fixed as \(T\downarrow0\); it is not uniform at the exponentially smaller zero-field activation edge.
Equivalent crossover formulas may exist under different finite-cluster Hamiltonian normalizations.
title: Two-scale low-temperature crossover in field-induced entanglement of a three-qubit XXX ring
